summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Sam Fletcher, an English football (soccer) full back born in Manchester in 1890 and who died in Cranston, Rhode Island in 1972. It states he played professionally in England, Canada and the United States, and that he later coached the Brown University soccer team.
one_line: Sam Fletcher was an English-born professional soccer full back who played in England, Canada and the US and later coached Brown University soccer.
key_facts: Sam Fletcher was born in 1890 in Manchester, England.
Sam Fletcher died on 22 January 1972 in Cranston, Rhode Island.
Sam Fletcher was an English football (soccer) full back.
Sam Fletcher played professionally in England.
Sam Fletcher played professionally in Canada.
Sam Fletcher played professionally in the United States.
Sam Fletcher later coached the Brown University soccer team.
